text:
Ok. now, if that is possible. so lets say

it turns into 1 quad when its idle. but i want to change tile 3 to plasma after the fact

can it still identify where the tile 3 space is
resolution: Follow-up answered: after collapsing to one quad, tile 3 remains addressable because the shader re-derives the tile grid from UV every frame — the per-tile effect assignment lives in the Effect data array, not the geometry. Swapping tile 3 to plasma is a single data[2] write; border blending updates automatically. Caveat noted: inside a StaticSurface a data change costs one re-bake. Click-to-tile mapping works in reverse via the same math.
